author: Universal Pictures
description:
Fall in love – with sustainability! 💚 YOU, ME & TUSCANY embraced a culture of reduction and reuse both behind the scenes and on screen: from director @KatCoiro spearheading the #LightsCameraPlastic campaign reducing single use plastics on screen, to featuring an Electric Fiat and cooktop, repurposing and donating materials from set, and more. YOU, ME & TUSCANY is in theaters now! #greenerlight 

Sometimes the wrong place is right where you need to be. 

From Will Packer, the blockbuster producer of Girls Trip, the Ride Along franchise, and ten movies that have opened No. 1 at the U.S. box office—including Night School, This Christmas and Think Like a Man—comes a delicious romantic comedy about one little lie, one large Italian villa, and two people getting lost in the sauce of love. 

Halle Bailey (The Little Mermaid, The Color Purple) stars as Anna, a young woman who has abandoned her dreams of becoming a chef and is now drifting through her twenties with a series of bad choices. Whe
